collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Two siblings are arguing loudly over a fishing spear, and their middle sibling steps in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two siblings are arguing loudly over a fishing spear, and their middle sibling, (name1), steps in.

choices.label: Ask What Each One Needs It For.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The siblings agree, and the argument ends.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They argue about who goes first, but it is a smaller argument.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: One needs it today and the other tomorrow, so there is no conflict.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Both need it now, so the middle sibling lends them a second spear.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The siblings eventually work it out themselves.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The argument drags on, and a parent steps in.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A pebble toss decides, and both accept the result.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The game becomes so fun that they forget the spear entirely.
